name: io.github.iowarp/fdmnes-mcp
title: CLIO Fdmnes
description: X-ray absorption near-edge spectra (XANES) of crystals and molecules with FDMNES: run, normalize...

tools.name: run_xanes
tools.description: Compute a XANES spectrum with FDMNES for a structure file: a crystal (CIF, POSCAR; periodic) or a molecule/cluster (XYZ, SDF, PDB). absorber: an element ('Fe'; every Fe site, FDMNES groups the equivalent ones) or a list of 0-based site indices (one spectrum each). edge: K, L1, L2, L3, L23, M45 …. method 'green' (multiple scattering, muffin-tin; fast, the usual first choice) or 'fdm' (finite differences, full potential; slow). radius: cluster radius in Å (6 is typical; convergence needs checking). scf: self-consistent potential (default on). energy_range: Emin, step, [E, step, …] Emax in eV from the Fermi level. Writes the FDMNES input and logs, spectrum CSVs (energy_eV, photon_energy_eV, mu, mu_norm) and result.json, and reports E0, white line and peaks. Minutes for a small crystal with green; much longer for fdm or large radii.

tools.name: read_spectrum
tools.description: Read a XANES spectrum (an FDMNES *_conv.txt, or a measured spectrum as two columns energy, absorption in text or CSV), shift its energies by energy_shift eV, normalize it (pre-edge line subtracted, divided by the edge step at E0, the steepest rise) and write a CSV with energy_eV, mu and mu_norm. Reports E0, white line and peaks; when the range is too short to normalize it says why.

tools.name: compare_spectra
tools.description: Compare two or more XANES spectra (FDMNES runs, spectrum CSVs from run_xanes, or measured two-column files): each is normalized; align true shifts each so its E0 matches the first (needed between a calculation, relative to the Fermi level, and a measurement, in photon energy); all are put on the first one's energy grid over the shared range. Writes one CSV (energy_eV and a column per spectrum) and reports each one's E0, shift, R-factor and correlation against the first.

tools.name: fetch_materials_project
tools.description: Crystal structures from the Materials Project by formula ('Fe3O4') or material id ('mp-19306'), written as CIF files (with magnetic moments when the material has them) under output_dir/chemistry/fdmnes/structures/. A formula returns every matching material within energy_above_hull_max eV/atom of the convex hull, up to max_results, ordered by energy above the hull, each with its space group, magnetic ordering and CIF path; none is chosen for you. Needs a Materials Project API key (MP_API_KEY; mp_key_missing otherwise).

tools.name: fdmnes_status
tools.description: Whether the FDMNES executable is available here, where it was found (FDMNES_COMMAND, FDMNES_EXE or PATH), and how to install it when it is not.
